summary: Flower entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Flower
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release, with PS3 motion-control route documented if compared

emulation.notes: Native PC or original PlayStation hardware routes.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release at documented settings; PS3 hardware for original input study

primary.why: The PC release is the most flexible current capture route for high-resolution recording, but the PlayStation 3 original's Sixaxis motion-control context remains historically important. iOS and later PlayStation ports are useful access/comparison routes.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam/GOG/Epic PC release for capture. Record storefront/build, resolution, controller or motion-input mapping, chapter/flower state, audio/display settings, and whether the PS3 original motion-control route was compared.

secondary.why: PC is current and easier to capture, but PS3 is the launch baseline.
PC remains the best capture route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record input method because motion/touch/controller mapping changes the feel.
